reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Fast at responding to messages, even when I made a mistake with the dates… They were happy to still come and collect the waste. Definitely made my life a lot easier and the dog is very grateful too!

reviews.name: Mia
reviews.text: Scoop Patrol provide an excellent, friendly, thorough service. They are both lovely & can't do enough to help. Always do a 5 star 🌟 job. I highly recommend them 👌🏻🥳

reviews.name: Valentina
reviews.text: …They made me feel comfortable straight away, never made me feel embarrassed, and treated me with kindness and respect. They went above and beyond, worked so hard, and did a fantastic job. They also charged so reasonably for the amount of effort they put in, and honestly deserved much more!
